summary: Implemented the window title feature in the rich repo. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True only when the title control is buffered on a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions, so Black formatting and test results are unverified.
